text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Showing off an overwhelming performance, 
Biwa Hayahide crossed the finish line 
ahead of Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having given it her all and earned Narita 
Taishin's acknowledgment of her strength 
once more, her expression was radiant.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket looked on enviously at the 
two of them having so much fun competing 
against each other, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series continues on. As long 
as they wish to, they can compete time and 
time again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The trio of "BNW" made a promise to face 
each other next in the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
